lines.text: The cat jumped in the box!
The cat jumped in the box. I'm dead!

data.define: Used when something is so funny that you can't stop laughing.

example.text: The cat jumped in the box. I'm dead!

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm dead' about a sad story.

data.l1_ex: बिल्ली बॉक्स में कूद गई। "I'm dead"।

native.tip: “I'm dead” = हँस-हँस कर लोटपोट. उदाहरण: “The cat jumped in the box. I'm dead!”
